alexgreensh-token-optimizer-fleet-audito.description: Audits token waste and cost across Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes and OpenCode, with dollar savings. Use when running several agent systems or suspecting idle heartbeats burn tokens.

alexgreensh-token-optimizer-resume-check.description: Pulls a prior session's checkpoint as fenced, scrubbed recovery context. Use when the user is continuing prior work; skip it on a fresh, unrelated task.

alexgreensh-token-optimizer-token-coach.description: Coaches a token-efficient Claude Code or Codex setup from the user's own usage data. Use when planning a build, fixing a slow or costly setup, or deciding which workflow steps need a model.

alexgreensh-token-optimizer-token-dashbo.description: Answers what a past session cost ("the Garden session yesterday", a session id) with a priced number, and opens the Token Optimizer dashboard when asked to see it.

alexgreensh-token-optimizer-token-optimi.description: Audits a Claude Code or Codex setup for context-window waste, fixes it with the user's approval, and measures the saving. Use when context feels tight, sessions degrade, or costs climb.

alexgreensh-token-optimizer-openclaw-tok.description: Audit your OpenClaw setup for token waste, context bloat, and cost optimization opportunities

alexgreensh-token-optimizer-devin.description: Explicitly filter private captured command output using Token Optimizer. Works on its own or as the manual fallback to automatic mode. No provider accounting.
